summary: ansible-test network-integration can target all of a platform's modules via regex (vyos_.*), one module, one test case with --testcase, or specific transports with --tags/--skip-tags.
questions: How do I run a single test case for a network module?
How do I run only nxapi tests?
Is vyos_.* a shell glob or a regex?

answer_card.title: Select network integration tests
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
INV=/path/to-collection-module/test/integration/inventory.networking
ansible-test network-integration --inventory $INV vyos_.*                # regex, not a glob
ansible-test network-integration --inventory $INV vyos_l3_interfaces
ansible-test network-integration --inventory $INV vyos_l3_interfaces --testcase gathered
ansible-test network-integration --inventory $INV --tags="nxapi" nxos_.*
ansible-test network-integration --inventory $INV --skip-tags="cli" nxos_.*
```
